correctness.rationale: For all q>=3,n>=3, each swap is legal iff the second-neighbor comparisons at all newly altered outside adjacencies hold. This proves s=Y_1+Y_L+sum_i Y_iY_{i+1}. Each binary profile has exactly q(q-1)(q-2)^(number of ones) realizations by sequential extension, giving the full enumerator. Its 2-state transfer matrix yields the stated rational formal series. An all-one profile uniquely maximizes, and a zero destroys at least two of its contributions; explicit 1^k0^(L-k) profiles attain every other possible degree. Independent-set enumeration of interior isolated bits, iid Bernoulli factorization, and explicit covariance pairs establish the remaining quantities. Three independent finite methods verify q=3,n<=9; q=4,n<=7; q=5,n<=6. These checks corroborate the infinite proof but do not replace it.
